changelog: New: Includes all improvements from versions 1.8.54 to 1.8.57 (new Drama workspace, Facebook Reels, TikTok and activation fixes)
Fixed: YouTube now downloads the quality you choose, including 1440p and 4K (it was limited to 1080p)
Fixed: MP3 mode downloads audio only and keeps the title and artist; saving Settings no longer switches MP3 back to Video
Fixed: Drama series - every episode downloads its own video and file name, and an episode is only marked Done after the video is checked to be playable
Changed: DramaShorts, NetShort and StardustTV download only episodes your account can watch; locked episodes now show a clear message
Fixed: Twitter/X, Instagram, Facebook photo and Xiaohongshu profile scans find posts again
Fixed: Crashes when searching the Drama Catalog while covers load, cancelling a profile scan, or closing during a conversion
Fixed: Pause and Remove stop a drama download immediately, and an interrupted download never replaces a finished file
Improved: Updates are checked with a SHA-256 checksum before they are installed
Improved: License checks while UltraGrab Pro is open now always take effect, even during downloads
Known issue: DramaBox downloads are currently unavailable because the DramaBox website blocks them
